description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class DoctrineService that extends the Doctrine class to manage Doctrine ORM's EntityManager, ensuring it is open before returning.

classes.name: DoctrineService
classes.description: A subclass of Doctrine that overrides getEntityManager() to ensure the EntityManager is open.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Overrides parent method to check if the EntityManager is open; if not, resets and reacquires it.
